description: Université Libre de Bruxelles publishes a 100-by-100-metre population-estimate grid for Dakar, Senegal. The raster was produced through a top-down dasymetric procedure that combines census information with detailed satellite-derived urban characteristics. The 2019 describing article documents the method, while the named Zenodo deposit supplies the compressed raster under CC BY 4.0. It can be obtained without payment and used to allocate infrastructure demand, service catchments or population exposure within the city. These values are modelled estimates, not household observations; their accuracy depends on source census units and the spatial redistribution assumptions. The internal raster encoding and numerical values were not inspected. This product complements the separately identified Dakar land-cover and street-block land-use resources. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. A limitation is that the present review verifies metadata only.
